free_tier.stated: 'Create an account and get 3 credits to unlock real links from day one.' The index itself is browsable, with 42M+ entries claimed on the page.
free_tier.notes: 3 credits is what an account buys before any purchase; the page does not publish a per-credit price on the surface read.

retention.stated: 'The index updates continuously, so new public links show up quickly and broken ones drop out of the results.'

egress.terms: no byte allowance: the site returns MEGA links, and the bytes come from mega.nz under a user's own MEGA transfer quota

interface_detail: HTML search only. /api and /documentation both return 404 on the same host, so no machine interface is advertised. A Telegram bot exists per the site's own documentation paths.
tooling: Browser or the Telegram bot. There is no documented REST endpoint; a client would have to drive the search page.
chaining: Use it to find a public MEGA link by filename, then hand that link to a debrid service that accepts MEGA, or to the MEGA client under the account's own transfer quota.

limits.value: credits, not requests: an account starts with 3 credits and each unlocked link spends one

limits_note: The credit model is the limit that binds, and it is counted per identity rather than per IP or per byte.
binding_note: The constraint that stops a user is the account and its credit balance, which is identity, not one of the seven byte or rate constraints.

identity_cost.detail: An account is required before a real link is revealed: the home page says an account gets 3 credits to unlock real links. Whether email alone is enough was not established, because the signup flow was not entered.

reliability_note: The index only sees links that were shared publicly; a link that the uploader deleted disappears from results, and the page itself frames results as 'no dead ends' without saying how often it re-checks.
confidence_note: The home page was read on 2026-10-23 and the two plausible API paths returned 404.

evidence.proved: 'Find MEGA links, files & folders across 42M+ indexed entries' and 'Create an account and get 3 credits to unlock real links from day one'
HTTP 404, so no API is served at that path
HTTP 404, so the documentation path the site implies is not at that address

notes: One of three MEGA search fronts found in a single query (meganz.net, meawfy, zippysharedjs). All three are link indexes over publicly shared MEGA folders, so none can see a private file; the distinction between them is whether the link costs an account, which here it does.
